<!--
Project: Frailty_Komoto 2022 Komodo Medicare comparative result table
Author: Nemo Zhou
Date started: 2026-07-17
Date last updated: 2026-08-05

Purpose:
This R Markdown report creates the aggregate-only Table 1 specified in
Documents/14_2022_MEDICARE_COMPARATIVE_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md. It is run after
Code/2_variable construction/7.1_add_census_region_and_rurality.R, queries
the configured 2022 comparison clinical-metrics-with-utilization table and the
embedded utilization indicators, and compares the Komodo populations specified
in the analysis plan. The broader comparison denominator is retained for all
measures; CFI rows are summarized only among patient-years with a nonmissing
reused CFI score and a same-year non-inpatient event. It renders the two
Komodo-only tables specified in the plan: the full broader overall denominator
and a plan-specific Komodo MA versus Komodo FFS table. Age groups are rows
within each table rather than separate strata. Dual eligibility is reported
only in the plan-specific table when Medicare and Medicaid occur together in
either primary/secondary order on any 2022 insurance span. HIV status is reported in the
selected-CCW section using the annual `hiv_status` indicator. Medicare columns
are reserved for the external CMS analysis and are not populated here.
No patient-level or utilization-level rows are collected locally. No Redshift
table is created or modified.
-->

find_project_root <- function() {
  candidates <- normalizePath(
    c(
      getwd(),
      file.path(getwd(), ".."),
      file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."),
      file.path(getwd(), "..", "..", "..")
    ),
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = FALSE
  )

  for (candidate in unique(candidates)) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "Documents", "00_DOCUMENTS_INDEX.md"))) {
      return(candidate)
    }
  }
  stop("Could not locate the Frailty_Komoto project root.")
}

}

resolve_project_path <- function(path_value, root) {
  if (is.null(path_value) || length(path_value) == 0L || !nzchar(path_value)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  path_value <- as.character(path_value[[1]])
  if (grepl("^([A-Za-z]:[\\\\/]|/)", path_value)) {
    return(normalizePath(path_value, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  }

  normalizePath(file.path(root, path_value), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

sql_string_local <- function(value) {
  paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", value, fixed = TRUE), "'")
}

quote_identifier_local <- function(identifier) {
  paste0('"', gsub('"', '""', identifier, fixed = TRUE), '"')
}

format_integer <- function(value) {
  format(as.numeric(value), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}

format_sample_size <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value < 11) "[suppressed]" else format_integer(value)
}

format_decimal <- function(value, digits = 1L) {
  formatC(as.numeric(value), format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
}

format_count_pct <- function(n, pct) {
  if (is.na(n) || is.na(pct)) return("[suppressed]")
  paste0(format_integer(n), " (", format_decimal(100 * pct), "%)")
}

format_continuous <- function(stat_row, mean_sd = TRUE, digits = 1L) {
  if (stat_row$suppression_applied == "yes") return("[suppressed]")
  if (is.na(stat_row$mean_value)) return("NA")
  if (mean_sd) {
    return(paste0(
      format_decimal(stat_row$mean_value, digits = digits),
      " (",
      format_decimal(stat_row$sd_value, digits = digits),
      ")"
    ))
  }
  paste0(
    format_decimal(stat_row$median_value, digits = digits),
    " (",
    format_decimal(stat_row$iqr_value, digits = digits),
    ")"
  )
}

make_row <- function(characteristic, values, group_labels) {
  values <- as.character(values)
  names(values) <- group_labels
  data.frame(
    c(list(Characteristic = characteristic), as.list(values)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

selected_ccw_conditions <- data.frame(
  condition_id = c(
    "acute_myocardial_infarction",
    "diabetes",
    "heart_failure",
    "hypertension",
    "ischemic_heart_disease",
    "alzheimers_disease",
    "chronic_kidney_disease",
    "copd",
    "depressive_mood_disorders",
    "hip_and_pelvic_fracture",
    "cancer",
    "hiv_status"
  ),
  label = c(
    "Acute myocardial infarction",
    "Diabetes",
    "Heart failure",
    "Hypertension",
    "Ischemic heart disease",
    "Alzheimer's disease and related disorder",
    "Chronic kidney disease",
    "Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease",
    "Depression",
    "Hip or pelvic fracture",
    "Cancer",
    "HIV"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
selected_ccw_conditions$indicator_column <- ifelse(
  selected_ccw_conditions$condition_id == "hiv_status",
  "hiv_status",
  paste0("ccw_", selected_ccw_conditions$condition_id)
)

run_aggregate_queries <- function(comparison_mode = c("overall", "plans")) {
  comparison_mode <- match.arg(comparison_mode)
  connection_output <- capture.output({
    con <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(connect_komodo()))
  })
  on.exit(disconnect_komodo(con), add = TRUE)

  config <- get_annual_healthcare_utilization_config()
  main_identifier <- qualified_identifier(write_schema, analysis_table)

  main_columns <- tolower(names(DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste0("SELECT * FROM ", main_identifier, " LIMIT 0")
  )))
  required_main_columns <- c(
    "patient_id",
    "analysis_year",
    "mx_insurance_group",
    "mx_insurance_segment",
    "age",
    "patient_gender",
    "patient_race_ethnicity",
    "mx_secondary_insurance_group",
    "overall_comparison_eligible",
    "plan_comparison_eligible",
    "plan_comparison_group",
    "pooled_medicare_segment",
    "n_valid_medicare_segments",
    "has_same_year_non_inpatient_event",
    "has_medicare_medicaid_dual_coverage",
    "census_region",
    "rurality_group",
    "cfi_score",
    "gagne_score",
    selected_ccw_conditions$indicator_column,
    "acute_inpatient_any_visit",
    "skilled_nursing_any_visit",
    "long_term_care_any_visit",
    "ed_visit_type_any_visit",
    "ed_service_subcategory_any_visit",
    "ed_revenue_code_any_visit"
  )
  missing_main_columns <- setdiff(required_main_columns, main_columns)
  if (length(missing_main_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Enriched clinical-metrics table is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_main_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  duplicate_check <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste0(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id || '|' || analysis_year::VARCHAR) ",
      "AS duplicate_patient_year_rows FROM ",
      main_identifier,
      " WHERE analysis_year = ",
      selected_analysis_year
    )
  )
  if (duplicate_check$duplicate_patient_year_rows[[1]] != 0) {
    stop("The enriched table contains duplicate 2022 patient-year rows.")
  }

  comparison_contract_qa <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste0(
      "SELECT 'overall eligibility flag is binary' AS check,\n",
      "  SUM(CASE WHEN overall_comparison_eligible NOT IN (0, 1)\n",
      "            OR overall_comparison_eligible IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT AS observed\n",
      "FROM ", main_identifier, " WHERE analysis_year = ", selected_analysis_year, "\n",
      "UNION ALL\n",
      "SELECT 'plan rows have one pooled Medicare segment and a valid plan group',\n",
      "  SUM(CASE WHEN plan_comparison_eligible = 1\n",
      "            AND (n_valid_medicare_segments <> 1\n",
      "                 OR UPPER(TRIM(plan_comparison_group)) NOT IN ('MA', 'FFS'))\n",
      "           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT\n",
      "FROM ", main_identifier, " WHERE analysis_year = ", selected_analysis_year, "\n",
      "UNION ALL\n",
      "SELECT 'nonmissing CFI scores have same-year non-inpatient evidence',\n",
      "  SUM(CASE WHEN cfi_score IS NOT NULL\n",
      "            AND has_same_year_non_inpatient_event <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT\n",
      "FROM ", main_identifier, " WHERE analysis_year = ", selected_analysis_year, "\n",
      "UNION ALL\n",
      "SELECT 'dual-coverage flag is binary',\n",
      "  SUM(CASE WHEN has_medicare_medicaid_dual_coverage NOT IN (0, 1)\n",
      "            OR has_medicare_medicaid_dual_coverage IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT\n",
      "FROM ", main_identifier, " WHERE analysis_year = ", selected_analysis_year
    )
  )
  if (any(comparison_contract_qa$observed != 0)) {
    stop("Comparison-table contract QA failed; inspect the configured analysis table.")
  }

  main_column <- function(column) {
    quote_identifier_local(column)
  }

  if (comparison_mode == "overall") {
    comparison_group_sql <- "'Komodo'"
    eligibility_filter_sql <- paste0(
      "AND ", main_column("overall_comparison_eligible"), " = 1"
    )
    expected_groups <- "Komodo"
  } else {
    comparison_group_sql <- paste0(
      "CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(m.", main_column("plan_comparison_group"), ")) = 'MA' ",
      "THEN 'Komodo MA' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(m.", main_column("plan_comparison_group"), ")) = 'FFS' ",
      "THEN 'Komodo FFS' END"
    )
    eligibility_filter_sql <- paste0(
      "AND ", main_column("plan_comparison_eligible"), " = 1 ",
      "AND UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("plan_comparison_group"), ")) IN ('MA', 'FFS')"
    )
    expected_groups <- c("Komodo MA", "Komodo FFS")
  }
  base_cte <- paste0(
    "WITH base AS (\n",
    "  SELECT m.*, ",
    comparison_group_sql,
    " AS comparison_group\n",
    "  FROM ",
    main_identifier,
    " m\n",
    "  WHERE analysis_year = ",
    selected_analysis_year,
    "\n    ", eligibility_filter_sql,
    ")"
  )

  group_denominators <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste0(
      base_cte,
      "\nSELECT comparison_group, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n_eligible\n",
      "FROM base\nGROUP BY comparison_group\nORDER BY comparison_group"
    )
  )
  if (!all(expected_groups %in% group_denominators$comparison_group)) {
    stop(
      "The enriched table does not contain both required comparison groups. Found: ",
      paste(group_denominators$comparison_group, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  group_denominators <- group_denominators[
    match(expected_groups, group_denominators$comparison_group),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  age_group_expression <- paste0(
    "CASE\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("age"), " BETWEEN 65 AND 74 THEN '65-74'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("age"), " BETWEEN 75 AND 84 THEN '75-84'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("age"), " >= 85 THEN '85+'\n",
    "  ELSE 'Unknown'\nEND"
  )
  sex_expression <- paste0(
    "CASE\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_gender"), ")) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'Female'\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_gender"), ")) IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'Male'\n",
    "  ELSE 'Unknown'\nEND"
  )
  race_expression <- paste0(
    "CASE\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_race_ethnicity"), ")) = 'WHITE' THEN 'White'\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_race_ethnicity"), ")) = 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN' THEN 'Black or African American'\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_race_ethnicity"), ")) = 'ASIAN OR PACIFIC ISLANDER' THEN 'Asian or Pacific Islander'\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_race_ethnicity"), ")) = 'HISPANIC OR LATINO' THEN 'Hispanic or Latino'\n",
    "  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(", main_column("patient_race_ethnicity"), ")) = 'OTHER' THEN 'Other'\n",
    "  ELSE 'Unknown'\nEND"
  )
  region_expression <- paste0(
    "COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(", main_column("census_region"), "), ''), 'Unknown')"
  )
  rurality_expression <- paste0(
    "COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(", main_column("rurality_group"), "), ''), 'Unknown')"
  )
  cfi_expression <- paste0(
    "CASE\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("cfi_score"), " < 0.15 THEN 'Robust'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("cfi_score"), " < 0.25 THEN 'Prefrail'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("cfi_score"), " >= 0.25 THEN 'Frail'\n",
    "  ELSE 'Unknown'\nEND"
  )
  gagne_expression <- paste0(
    "CASE\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("gagne_score"), " < 0 THEN '<0'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("gagne_score"), " = 0 THEN '0'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("gagne_score"), " BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("gagne_score"), " BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5'\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("gagne_score"), " >= 6 THEN '6+'\n",
    "  ELSE 'Unknown'\nEND"
  )
  dual_eligibility_expression <- paste0(
    "CASE\n",
    "  WHEN ", main_column("has_medicare_medicaid_dual_coverage"), " = 1 THEN 'Yes'\n",
    "  ELSE 'No'\nEND"
  )

  categorical_specs <- list(
    age_group = list(
      expression = age_group_expression,
      categories = c("65-74", "75-84", "85+", "Unknown")
    ),
    sex = list(
      expression = sex_expression,
      categories = c("Female", "Male", "Unknown")
    ),
    race_ethnicity = list(
      expression = race_expression,
      categories = c(
        "White", "Black or African American", "Asian or Pacific Islander",
        "Hispanic or Latino", "Other", "Unknown"
      )
    ),
    census_region = list(
      expression = region_expression,
      categories = c("Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West")
    ),
    rurality = list(
      expression = rurality_expression,
      categories = c("Metro", "Urban", "Rural")
    ),
    cfi_category = list(
      expression = cfi_expression,
      categories = c("Robust", "Prefrail", "Frail")
    ),
    gagne_level = list(
      expression = gagne_expression,
      categories = c("<0", "0", "1-2", "3-5", "6+", "Unknown")
    )
  )
  if (comparison_mode == "plans") {
    categorical_specs$dual_eligibility <- list(
      expression = dual_eligibility_expression,
      categories = c("Yes", "No")
    )
  }
  cfi_row_filter_sql <- paste0(
    main_column("cfi_score"), " IS NOT NULL AND ",
    main_column("has_same_year_non_inpatient_event"), " = 1"
  )

  run_categorical_query <- function(
    variable,
    expression,
    categories,
    row_filter_sql = NULL
  ) {
    from_sql <- if (is.null(row_filter_sql)) {
      "FROM base"
    } else {
      paste0("FROM base WHERE ", row_filter_sql)
    }
    parts <- lapply(categories, function(category) {
      numerator_sql <- paste0(
        "SUM(CASE WHEN ", expression, " = ", sql_string_local(category),
        " THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)"
      )
      paste0(
        "SELECT comparison_group, ", sql_string_local(variable),
        " AS variable, ", sql_string_local(category),
        " AS category, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n_eligible,\n",
        "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql, " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE ",
        numerator_sql, " END::BIGINT AS category_n,\n",
        "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql, " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE ",
        numerator_sql, "::DOUBLE PRECISION / COUNT(*) END AS category_pct,\n",
        "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql,
        " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS suppression_applied\n",
        from_sql, "\nGROUP BY comparison_group"
      )
    })
    DBI::dbGetQuery(
      con,
      paste0(
        base_cte, "\n", paste(parts, collapse = "\nUNION ALL\n"),
        "\nORDER BY comparison_group, category"
      )
    )
  }

  categorical_results <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(names(categorical_specs), function(variable) {
      spec <- categorical_specs[[variable]]
      run_categorical_query(
        variable,
        spec$expression,
        spec$categories,
        row_filter_sql = if (variable == "cfi_category") {
          cfi_row_filter_sql
        } else {
          NULL
        }
      )
    })
  )

  ccw_parts <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(selected_ccw_conditions)), function(index) {
    condition <- selected_ccw_conditions[index, , drop = FALSE]
    flag_expression <- main_column(condition$indicator_column)
    numerator_sql <- paste0(
      "SUM(CASE WHEN ", flag_expression, " = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)"
    )
    paste0(
      "SELECT comparison_group, ", sql_string_local(condition$condition_id),
      " AS variable, 'Present' AS category, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n_eligible,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql, " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE ",
      numerator_sql, " END::BIGINT AS category_n,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql, " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE ",
      numerator_sql, "::DOUBLE PRECISION / COUNT(*) END AS category_pct,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql,
      " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS suppression_applied\n",
      "FROM base\nGROUP BY comparison_group"
    )
  })
  categorical_results <- rbind(
    categorical_results,
    DBI::dbGetQuery(
      con,
      paste0(
        base_cte, "\n", paste(ccw_parts, collapse = "\nUNION ALL\n"),
        "\nORDER BY comparison_group, variable"
      )
    )
  )

  continuous_specs <- list(
    age = list(column = "age", row_filter_sql = NULL),
    cfi_score = list(column = "cfi_score", row_filter_sql = cfi_row_filter_sql),
    gagne_score = list(column = "gagne_score", row_filter_sql = NULL)
  )
  continuous_parts <- lapply(names(continuous_specs), function(metric) {
    spec <- continuous_specs[[metric]]
    column_expression <- main_column(spec$column)
    from_sql <- if (is.null(spec$row_filter_sql)) {
      "FROM base"
    } else {
      paste0("FROM base WHERE ", spec$row_filter_sql)
    }
    paste0(
      "SELECT comparison_group, ", sql_string_local(metric),
      " AS metric, COUNT(", column_expression, ")::BIGINT AS n_nonmissing,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN COUNT(", column_expression, ") BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(",
      column_expression, "::DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS mean_value,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN COUNT(", column_expression, ") BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(",
      column_expression, "::DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS sd_value,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN COUNT(", column_expression, ") BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ",
      column_expression, ") END AS p25,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN COUNT(", column_expression, ") BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ",
      column_expression, ") END AS median_value,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN COUNT(", column_expression, ") BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ",
      column_expression, ") END AS p75,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN COUNT(", column_expression, ") BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS suppression_applied\n",
      from_sql, "\nGROUP BY comparison_group"
    )
  })
  continuous_results <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste0(
      base_cte, "\n", paste(continuous_parts, collapse = "\nUNION ALL\n"),
      "\nORDER BY comparison_group, metric"
    )
  )
  continuous_results$iqr_value <- continuous_results$p75 - continuous_results$p25

  utilization_specs <- data.frame(
    category = c(
      "Acute Inpatient",
      "Skilled Nursing",
      "Long-term care",
      "Emergency department: visit type",
      "Emergency department: service subcategory",
      "Emergency department: revenue code"
    ),
    prefix = c(
      "acute_inpatient",
      "skilled_nursing",
      "long_term_care",
      "ed_visit_type",
      "ed_service_subcategory",
      "ed_revenue_code"
    ),
    report_label = c(
      "Hospitalization",
      "Skilled Nursing",
      "Long-term care",
      "Emergency department (visit type)",
      "Emergency department (service subcategory)",
      "Emergency department (revenue code)"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  utilization_prevalence_parts <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(utilization_specs)), function(index) {
    item <- utilization_specs[index, , drop = FALSE]
    any_visit_expression <- main_column(paste0(item$prefix, "_any_visit"))
    numerator_sql <- paste0(
      "SUM(CASE WHEN ", any_visit_expression, " = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)"
    )
    paste0(
      "SELECT comparison_group, ", sql_string_local(item$category),
      " AS utilization_category, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n_eligible,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql, " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE ",
      numerator_sql, " END::BIGINT AS n_patients_with_visit,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql, " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN NULL ELSE ",
      numerator_sql, "::DOUBLE PRECISION / COUNT(*) END AS pct_patient_years_with_visit,\n",
      "  CASE WHEN ", numerator_sql,
      " BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS suppression_applied\n",
      "FROM base\nGROUP BY comparison_group"
    )
  })
  utilization_prevalence <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste0(
      base_cte, "\n", paste(utilization_prevalence_parts, collapse = "\nUNION ALL\n"),
      "\nORDER BY comparison_group, utilization_category"
    )
  )

  list(
    group_denominators = group_denominators,
    comparison_contract_qa = comparison_contract_qa,
    categorical = categorical_results,
    continuous = continuous_results,
    utilization_prevalence = utilization_prevalence,
    utilization_specs = utilization_specs
  )
}

table_definitions <- list(
  overall = list(label = "Overall population", comparison_mode = "overall"),
  plans = list(label = "Medicare plan comparison", comparison_mode = "plans")
)

aggregate_inputs <- lapply(
  table_definitions,
  function(table_definition) {
    run_aggregate_queries(table_definition$comparison_mode)
  }
)
if ("dual_eligibility" %in% unique(aggregate_inputs$overall$categorical$variable)) {
  stop("Overall Table 1 must not report dual eligibility.")
}
if (!"dual_eligibility" %in% unique(aggregate_inputs$plans$categorical$variable)) {
  stop("Plan-specific Table 2 must report dual eligibility.")
}
utils::write.csv(
  aggregate_inputs$overall$comparison_contract_qa,
  file.path(result_output_dir, "3.1_2022_komodo_medicare_table1_contract_qa.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

render_table <- function(table_label, inputs, table_number, csv_stub) {
  group_labels <- as.character(inputs$group_denominators$comparison_group)

  get_category_row <- function(variable, category, group) {
    rows <- inputs$categorical[
      inputs$categorical$variable == variable &
        inputs$categorical$category == category &
        inputs$categorical$comparison_group == group,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(rows) == 0L) return(NULL)
    rows[1, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  category_cell <- function(variable, category, group) {
    row <- get_category_row(variable, category, group)
    if (is.null(row)) return("[suppressed]")
    format_count_pct(row$category_n[[1]], row$category_pct[[1]])
  }
  get_continuous_row <- function(metric, group) {
    rows <- inputs$continuous[
      inputs$continuous$metric == metric &
        inputs$continuous$comparison_group == group,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(rows) == 0L) return(NULL)
    rows[1, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  continuous_cell <- function(metric, group, mean_sd = TRUE, digits = 1L) {
    row <- get_continuous_row(metric, group)
    if (is.null(row)) return("[suppressed]")
    format_continuous(row[1, , drop = FALSE], mean_sd = mean_sd, digits = digits)
  }
  category_values <- function(variable, category) {
    vapply(
      group_labels,
      function(group) category_cell(variable, category, group),
      character(1)
    )
  }
  continuous_values <- function(metric, mean_sd = TRUE, digits = 1L) {
    vapply(
      group_labels,
      function(group) continuous_cell(metric, group, mean_sd, digits),
      character(1)
    )
  }

  table_rows <- list()
  append_row <- function(characteristic, values = rep("", length(group_labels))) {
    table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1L]] <<- make_row(
      characteristic,
      values,
      group_labels
    )
  }
  append_section <- function(label) {
    append_row(paste0("<span class=\"section-label\"><strong>", label, "</strong></span>"))
  }
  append_subrow <- function(label, variable, category) {
    append_row(
      paste0("<span class=\"subrow\">", label, "</span>"),
      category_values(variable, category)
    )
  }

  append_section("Population and demographics")
  append_row(
    "Sample size, n",
    vapply(
      group_labels,
      function(group) format_sample_size(
        inputs$group_denominators$n_eligible[
          inputs$group_denominators$comparison_group == group
        ][1]
      ),
      character(1)
    )
  )
  append_row("Age, years, mean (SD)", continuous_values("age"))
  append_row("Age, years, median (IQR)", continuous_values("age", FALSE))
  append_row("Age group, n (%)")
  append_subrow("65-74 years", "age_group", "65-74")
  append_subrow("75-84 years", "age_group", "75-84")
  append_subrow("85 years or older", "age_group", "85+")
  append_row("Sex, n (%)")
  for (category in c("Female", "Male", "Unknown")) {
    append_subrow(category, "sex", category)
  }
  append_row("Race/ethnicity, n (%)")
  for (category in c("White", "Black or African American", "Asian or Pacific Islander", "Hispanic or Latino", "Other", "Unknown")) {
    append_subrow(category, "race_ethnicity", category)
  }
  if ("dual_eligibility" %in% unique(inputs$categorical$variable)) {
    append_row("Dual eligibility, n (%)")
    append_subrow("Yes", "dual_eligibility", "Yes")
  }
  append_row("Census region, n (%)")
  for (category in c("Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West")) {
    append_subrow(category, "census_region", category)
  }
  append_row("Residence rurality, n (%)")
  for (category in c("Metro", "Urban", "Rural")) {
    append_subrow(category, "rurality", category)
  }

  append_section("Clinical metrics")
  append_row("CFI score, mean (SD)", continuous_values("cfi_score", TRUE, 2L))
  append_row("CFI score, median (IQR)", continuous_values("cfi_score", FALSE, 2L))
  append_row("CFI category, n (%)")
  append_subrow("Robust (&lt;0.15)", "cfi_category", "Robust")
  append_subrow("Prefrail (0.15-&lt;0.25)", "cfi_category", "Prefrail")
  append_subrow("Frail (&gt;=0.25)", "cfi_category", "Frail")
  append_row("Gagne score, mean (SD)", continuous_values("gagne_score"))
  append_row("Gagne score, median (IQR)", continuous_values("gagne_score", FALSE))
  append_row("Gagne level, n (%)")
  for (category in c("<0", "0", "1-2", "3-5", "6+")) {
    append_subrow(if (category == "<0") "&lt;0" else category, "gagne_level", category)
  }

  append_row("Selected CCW conditions, n (%)")
  for (index in seq_len(nrow(selected_ccw_conditions))) {
    condition <- selected_ccw_conditions[index, , drop = FALSE]
    append_subrow(condition$label, condition$condition_id, "Present")
  }

  append_section("Healthcare utilization")
  for (index in seq_len(nrow(inputs$utilization_specs))) {
    utilization <- inputs$utilization_specs[index, , drop = FALSE]
    prevalence_cells <- vapply(
      group_labels,
      function(group) {
        rows <- inputs$utilization_prevalence[
          inputs$utilization_prevalence$utilization_category == utilization$category &
            inputs$utilization_prevalence$comparison_group == group,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
        if (nrow(rows) == 0L) return("[suppressed]")
        format_count_pct(
          rows$n_patients_with_visit[[1]],
          rows$pct_patient_years_with_visit[[1]]
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
    append_row(
      paste0(utilization$report_label, ", n (%)"),
      prevalence_cells
    )
  }

  table_output <- do.call(rbind, table_rows)
  table_csv_path <- file.path(
    result_output_dir,
    paste0("3.1_2022_komodo_medicare_table1_", csv_stub, ".csv")
  )
  utils::write.csv(table_output, table_csv_path, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  list(
    title = paste0(
      "Table ", table_number,
      ". Characteristics of older adults (65+) in Komodo, 2022 (",
      table_label,
      ")"
    ),
    data = table_output
  )
}

rendered_tables <- list(
  render_table("Overall population", aggregate_inputs$overall, "1", "overall"),
  render_table("Medicare plan comparison", aggregate_inputs$plans, "2", "plans")
)

}
